label: Привіт
description: Hello. Lumen pokes his head out of his cape, tries to wave but one paw gets tangled in a too-long cape sleeve; then proudly frees it and waves. Frame 1 peeking, frame 2 sleeve tangled and puzzled, frame 3 freeing paw, frame 4 big happy wave.

label: Смішно
description: Laughing. Lumen hears a hilarious joke, tries to remain dignified, then laughs so hard his enormous ears flap like little wings and his cape lifts. Frame 1 tiny smirk, frame 2 shoulders shaking, frame 3 roaring laugh with floppy ears thrown upward, frame 4 wiping a tiny tear and calming down.

label: Не можу
description: Rolling with laughter. Lumen laughs and tips sideways into a round fluffy ball, rolls upside-down showing his little paws and blue cape, then sits up with a ridiculous triumphant grin. Frame 1 laughing and leaning, frame 2 sideways rolling, frame 3 upside down fluffy ball, frame 4 seated grinning.

label: Захоплення
description: Lumen sees something wonderful: frame1 surprised wide eyes, frame2 heart-shaped highlights grow in eyes, frame3 ears soften and amulet glows a bright heart, frame4 dreamy embarrassed smile with paws to cheeks.

label: Обійми
description: Lumen hugs an absurdly oversized soft red heart. Frame1 peeks from behind heart, frame2 struggles to wrap paws around it, frame3 squeezes heart and disappears behind it, frame4 pops head back up smiling.

label: Любов
description: Lumen shyly gifts a tiny glowing heart from his golden amulet. Frame1 paws over amulet, frame2 tiny heart emerges, frame3 offers it in both paws with bashful ears, frame4 hides half face in cape smiling.

label: Цьом
description: Lumen blows a kiss so enthusiastic that the recoil pushes him onto his fluffy bottom. Frame1 kiss on paw, frame2 blows small red heart, frame3 recoils losing balance with wide eyes, frame4 seated sheepishly waving.

label: Круто
description: Lumen tries to be impossibly cool in black sunglasses. Frame1 raises sunglasses, frame2 proud superhero pose, frame3 glasses slide down tiny nose, frame4 hurriedly pushes them back up with ridiculous dignity.

label: Думаю
description: Lumen uses his golden amulet as an unreliable idea lamp. Frame1 puzzled paw to chin, frame2 taps dark amulet, frame3 shakes it with concentrated face, frame4 amulet lights up and ears perk in eureka.

label: Підозріло
description: Lumen investigates a suspicious statement with an absurdly oversized magnifying glass. Frame1 raised eyebrow, frame2 pulls glass from cape, frame3 one comically enlarged blue eye through lens, frame4 knowing suspicious side-eye.

label: Хитро
description: Lumen has a mischievous harmless secret. Frame1 innocent face, frame2 sly sideways smile, frame3 hides smile behind navy cape collar, frame4 ears stick straight up betraying how pleased he is.

label: Ну звісно
description: Lumen reacts to a very obvious excuse. Frame1 listens politely, frame2 slowly rolls eyes upward, frame3 ears fold down in exhausted disbelief, frame4 looks straight ahead with tiny resigned smile.

label: Пронесло
description: Lumen pretends everything went according to plan while hiding a tiny broken toy rocket. Frame1 sheepish grin holding tiny broken rocket, frame2 glances aside, frame3 sweeps rocket pieces under cape, frame4 wipes one sweat drop with nervous grin.

label: Ніяково
description: Lumen survives an extremely awkward moment. Frame1 frozen toothy smile, frame2 eyes dart sideways, frame3 pulls blue cape over head, frame4 only large turquoise ears and embarrassed eyes peek out.

label: Я все
description: Lumen melts with embarrassment into a cute soft plush puddle, no horror. Frame1 embarrassed warm face, frame2 body softly squashes, frame3 cream turquoise fluffy puddle with eyes and amulet on top, frame4 slowly reforms with sheepish grin.

label: Тримаюся
description: Lumen bravely tries to smile while catching one stubborn cartoon tear. Frame1 hopeful small smile, frame2 one large shiny tear appears, frame3 catches it with tiny cup, frame4 smiles and shows cup as if it was the plan.

label: Драма
description: Lumen is theatrically melodramatic, floating in his cape folded as a tiny boat on two exaggerated cartoon tears. Frame1 big pout, frame2 fountain tears fill little cape boat, frame3 sitting in cape boat bobbing dramatically, frame4 dabs eyes and peeks to see reaction.

label: Обурення
description: Lumen tries to look terrifying but stomps so hard that he bounces himself into the air. Frame1 puffed cheeks paws on hips, frame2 determined stomp, frame3 tiny accidental jump with surprised face, frame4 lands trying to retain dignity.

label: Вибух мозку
description: Lumen's mind is blown: his fluffy fur puffs into a huge spherical halo and amulet spins like a tiny planet. Frame1 concentrated face, frame2 shocked face fur begins expanding, frame3 fluffy round shockball with orbiting golden amulet, frame4 normal again but one ear crooked.

label: Паніка
description: Lumen startled by something harmless. Frame1 freezes wide-eyed, frame2 huge ears spring up as antennae, frame3 blue cape balloons like a parachute above his head, frame4 peeks from under cape to check if safe.

label: Ну як так
description: Lumen reacts to a ridiculous mistake. Frame1 looks in disbelief, frame2 one paw covers face, frame3 huge ear folds over that paw as extra facepalm, frame4 looks through tiny gap with weary comic expression.

label: Не знаю
description: Lumen has absolutely no idea. Frame1 puzzled tilted head, frame2 spreads both paws, frame3 amulet projects one large simple question-mark shape, frame4 shrugs so high his head sinks between fluffy shoulders. No written words.

label: Схвалюю
description: Lumen gives an extremely solemn approval. Frame1 thoughtful face, frame2 raises paw in clear thumbs-up cartoon gesture, frame3 exaggerated dignified nod tilts whole body forward, frame4 quickly regains balance still giving thumbs up.

label: Не годиться
description: Lumen firmly refuses a bad idea with comic politeness. Frame1 friendly skeptical look, frame2 shows small red circular crossed-out symbol with NO letters, frame3 turns it into oversized shield to hide behind, frame4 peeks around edge still shaking head.

label: Браво
description: Lumen applauds a brilliant achievement and gets carried away. Frame1 restrained polite clap, frame2 broad delighted clap, frame3 clapping above head while bouncing, frame4 gives proud tiny bow as if he also helped.

label: Прошу
description: Lumen asks for a favor with outrageously innocent eyes. Frame1 paws together, frame2 huge pleading blue eyes, frame3 far-too-large golden halo appears above ears, frame4 halo slips sideways and he straightens it innocently.

label: Потягнемо
description: Lumen acts like a heroic weightlifter but his dumbbell is made of marshmallows. Frame1 prepares with serious face, frame2 struggles lifting tiny dumbbell, frame3 holds it triumphantly overhead, frame4 bites one marshmallow end with pleased grin.

label: Вогонь
description: Lumen is so enthusiastic his amulet becomes a tiny campfire for roasting one marshmallow. Frame1 amulet glows warm, frame2 pulls marshmallow on stick from cape, frame3 roasts it over small golden magical flame, frame4 proudly eats toasted marshmallow. No burning character or distress.

label: Перемога
description: Lumen celebrates by opening his cape to release ridiculous colorful confetti. Frame1 proud anticipation holding cape shut, frame2 flings cape open, frame3 confetti blast gently pushes him backward, frame4 sits covered in confetti with triumphant grin.

label: Спати
description: Lumen goes to sleep wrapped in his blue cape, amulet as a warm nightlight. Frame1 sleepy yawn, frame2 curls into little fluffy ball inside cape, frame3 ears fold like blanket and eyes close, frame4 amulet dims to warm tiny nightlight as he snoozes. No text or Z letters.
